labelFr.description: French name, e.g. Place individuelle. Empty: the English name is used on the French site.

value.description: Short code, e.g. single or duo. Don't change it after people have registered.

seats.description: How many people it admits: 1 for a single seat, 2 for a duo pass.

priceInr.description: Price in rupees for the whole pass, e.g. 2499.

priceEur.description: Price in euros for the French site. Empty: this pass is not offered on the French site.
